r9_closure_status.reason: Four of the ten mandatory O1-C07 separate accounts - source-path existence/access checks, file hash passes, path-level opens and decoder invocations - have no exact per-source lawful bound anywhere in the governed evidence. C4B's warrant template specifies these accounts but supplies only requirement tokens (REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT / REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_AND_BASIS), deferring the numbers to issuance on the authorized execution surface. Omega-1's O1-C07 acceptance criterion requires expected budgets frozen before launch. That criterion is therefore not currently satisfiable.
r9_closure_status.what_this_candidate_achieves: It binds every layer the evidence does establish, with provenance, at the correct access layer, and converts every unestablished layer into an explicit, individually-identified, unfilled issuance-time obligation with a named prohibition on fabrication.
r9_closure_status.what_would_close_r9: Either (a) governing evidence that supplies exact per-source values for all four unbound accounts, or (b) an instrument-level determination of those four accounts made on the authorized execution surface and recorded with the four required measurement-basis fields - which is itself a warrant-issuance-time act requiring locator fill and the two approvals, neither of which exists.
r9_closure_status.explicitly_not_claimed: This candidate does not claim R9 closed at candidate grain. Independent hostile review and HQ adjudication remain required.
